rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and zip code, which matched a single user. It inspected the user’s orders with read-only tools, identified the correct delivered order containing the bicycle, and confirmed the exact action (returning only the bicycle and refunding to the original payment method—Mastercard ending 8484) before submitting any changes. After the user’s explicit confirmation, it executed the return on the correct item and order, and the tool response shows the return was requested with the correct payment method. Final information provided to the user matches the tool outputs. No unsupported claims or actions on another user’s account were made. While the agent did not list all recent orders after being asked, it directly identified the bicycle order and proceeded appropriately with user confirmation, which does not violate policy.
